assumptions.benchmark: equal weight of the same 22 instruments through the same ledger and costs; cash; SPY buy-and-hold as an unmatched reference
assumptions.costs: 10 bp commission + 5 bp slippage on traded notional, both sides (15 bp per side)
assumptions.data: Yahoo Finance public chart v8 daily bars; dividend/split-adjusted OHLC (current vintage at download)
assumptions.fills: at the next observed close after the decision; fractional units; long only
assumptions.limits: 80% gross, 10% per instrument, 35% growth group, 12% annualised volatility target, 40% turnover per rebalance, 3% cash buffer, 20% drawdown stop

decision_rule: An overlay is 'supported on this history' only if its Sharpe difference is positive with Holm p < 0.05. Otherwise it is 'not established'. Neither outcome changes the pilot.

deflated.note: Probability that the true Sharpe ratio exceeds the best value expected by luck among the counted trials. Earlier prototype backtests and the block-reset study portfolios are not counted, so these values are upper bounds.

parity.note: Same targets, prices, calendar and ledger as the sealed adaptive release.
